purpose: Teach: 瞬時/歳入/排気/後記/稼げる/頂けれ/興行/続出

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 対応、瞬時に、判断する力、社員に、求めろ。
lines.en: I want to see staff who can respond and make decisions in a split second.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Clipped pace on key phrases. Eyes level, speaking principle not performance. No room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。歳入見通し、財務に、報告いたします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the revenue forecast reported to finance right away.
lines.style: Respectful formality. Slightly faster pace to show readiness. Affirming nod in the voice. Clean, professional cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 工場の排気設備、環境基準、満たしているか、確認しろ。
lines.en: Check the factory exhaust equipment. Make sure it meets environmental standards.
lines.style: Steady, specific instruction. Slight pause before each task component. Not harsh — just clear expectation. Business-like but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内報、編集後記、社員からも、好評です。
lines.en: Yes. The company newsletter — the editorial actually got positive feedback from staff.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the detail. Warm undertone but still professional. Slight uptick at the positive note, then settling back to composed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新事業で、いかに、稼げる体制を、築くか、議題だ。
lines.en: The real agenda is this: how do we build a profitable structure for the new division?
lines.style: Measured intensity. Leans slightly forward on 'real agenda.' Deliberate pace. The voice of someone who sees the shape of the problem clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ご賛同、頂ければ、企画を、進めてまいります。
lines.en: Understood. We'll move forward with the proposal as soon as we have your approval.
lines.style: Formal assurance. Steady, reliable tone. Light emphasis on 'move forward' — showing momentum. Deferential without weakness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の興行、好調だな、引き続き、努力しろ。
lines.en: The box office this quarter is solid. Keep up the push.
lines.style: Firm acknowledgment. Short, efficient delivery. A moment of genuine approval in the middle, then back to the next task. Efficient praise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。注文、続出しております、生産、追いついていません。
lines.en: Yes. The orders keep coming, but production can't keep pace.
lines.style: Slight tension under the surface. 'Orders keep coming' with quiet satisfaction, then the admission of strain. Slight fatigue on the final thought.
